name: progresstracker
description: Employee Work Management & Productivity Tracker — repo-level orchestration for tests, lint and E2E

scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix Backend && npm test --prefix Frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --prefix Backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix Frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend && npm install
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
